title: Daily Reading Output (daily-reading-v3)
description: The structured artifact named by output_schema and the public response shapes for today's reading. M0 pinned the name 'daily-reading-v2' in readingAssemblyRequest without shipping a document for it, so the identity preimage committed to a schema nobody could validate against. v3 defines the exact shape assembleReading() returns, the shape hashed into content_hash, the shape GET and PUT /v1/readings/today return when published, and the preparation state PUT may return while the queue is working.

paragraphRole.description: Fixed assembly order. primary_theme is required unless the reading is a safety_fallback; supporting_theme, timing, uncertainty_notice, and context_label are conditional.

order.description: 1-based position. Contiguous and strictly increasing across the paragraph list.

text.description: Reviewed editorial copy, or a reviewed template with its closed placeholders filled by calculated values. The renderer authors no connective prose: every character here traces to an approved content version through the paragraph's evidence.

generated_at.description: The command's frozen generation_anchor, not the attempt time. A retry reports the same instant, which is what keeps the assembly id stable.

assembly_mode.description: M3 never calls a model. constrained_model is M5.

locale.description: The resolved locale actually rendered, after exact-match then configured language fallback then locale_default.

paragraphs.description: Never empty. A day with no eligible fact publishes the locale's reviewed universal fallback, not a blank reading.

fallback_used.description: Mirrors validationResult.fallback_used. True when no theme survived eligibility or a required validation check rejected the draft.

allOf.description: A fallback reading is exactly one safety_fallback paragraph; a normal reading carries no safety_fallback paragraph and must open with primary_theme.

evidence_url.description: Relative path to GET /v1/readings/{id}/evidence. The 'Why this?' affordance is part of the product surface, not an optional extra.
